categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Changes parameter validation in interfaces::Mining rather than IPC transport or serialization infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Mining interface changes belong to mining rather than ipc unless they modify IPC infrastructure itself.

categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Has the Mining label and modifies wait timeout validation in src/interfaces/mining.h and src/node/interfaces.cpp.
categories.rationale: Hardens the Mining interface against node-aborting debug assertions or invalid wait deadlines caused by negative or NaN timeouts. The author notes that no known client currently sends these values (e.g. sv2-tp enforces positive timeouts), making this defensive hardening against malformed inputs across the process boundary.
